name: Icarian Harpy
_notes: Transcribed from sheet CU1678 + trait card CX1679 (Rapid Adaptation), AI CR1695-CR1715, BP CS1716-CS1733.
Predator and Death by Fate are separate trait cards (not scanned). Death by Fate uses the Cycle III rulebook text; Predator is a placeholder.
Lv III/IV right box (+3 / +12 jar icon) is a campaign reward value — ignored. BP resource icons ignored.
Consumed (Cycle III rulebook p.4): the Titan dies (Instant Death).

traits.Rapid Adaptation: The track on this sheet represents the Icarian Adaptation Board. If you Wound the Icarian Harpy, after resolving Responses, place an Adaptation token on the Icarian Adaptation Board, on a space corresponding to your Weapon class. If there are no more Adaptation tokens outside of the Adaptation Board, move one of the tokens from the Adaptation Board onto this space. Any attempt to Wound with a Weapon class listed on a space covered with an Adaptation token will automatically Fail. During attempts with a Weapon class listed on a space adjacent to an Adaptation token, the Icarian Harpy gains +1 AT. This bonus can stack if a space is adjacent to two Adaptation tokens. Additional Setup: Level 1: 1 token. Level 2: 2 tokens. Level 3-4: 3 tokens. Level 5-6: 4 tokens. Level 7+: 5 tokens. (Spaces, clockwise: Sword · Knife & Spear · Club & Slabsword · Cestus & Hammer & Discus · Shield · Whip & Axe & Other · Javelin & Bow & Blade)
traits.Predator: Start of Battle: Starting from the highest DANGER and continuing in descending order, Titans suffer: Level 1: Bleeding 2, Bleeding 1. Level 2: Bleeding 2, Bleeding 2. Level 3: Bleeding 2, Bleeding 2, Bleeding 1. Level 4+: Bleeding 3, Bleeding 2, Bleeding 2. ⚡ End of Primordial Round: Titan with the most Bleeding tokens in Sight that has not been Attacked this Round becomes the Target of Predation. If there is no eligible Target, Predation doesn't trigger.
traits.Regurgitate: Regurgitate: Place an Ambrosia Pool Terrain tile beneath the Primordial. Level 2+: Treat all Ambrosia Pools as Black Glaciers.
traits.Death by Fate: When a Primordial Attack deals FATE, it triggers a Trauma Draw (like DANGER). If an Attack deals both, resolve only one Trauma Draw. Being dealt FATE over 9 causes an Obol Draw instead of a Moiros Draw. Trauma severity uses the higher of DANGER or FATE.
traits.Deep Cut: End of Titan turn: Gain DANGER equal to the number of Bleeding tokens you have.
traits.Devour Whole: Start of Primordial Round: Consume all Titans adjacent to the Icarian Harpy.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Tentacled Monstrosity: +3 to all Pulls performed by Harpy.
traits.Bloodlost: Start of Battle: Starting from the highest DANGER and continuing in descending order, Titans suffer: Bleeding 4, Bleeding 3, Bleeding 2 and Bleeding 2. This Trait overrides the Start of Battle effect of the Predator Trait.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Bleed Your Heart Out: Each Bleeding token gives you a cumulative -1 Speed. Bleeding Limit -1.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Rupture Veins: Instead of the normal Bleeding Build-up, gain as many Bleeding tokens as there are Bleeding tokens on your Titan.
traits.Perfection: End of Titan Round: Place an additional generic token on top of any Rapid Adaptation Token on the Icarian Adaptation Board. This Adaptation token cannot be moved or removed until the end of Battle.
